published.en: Mosaic club session. Admission requires age 16 through 80 inclusive and at least one of resident, student, or member status. Anyone under 18 must also have guardian consent; adults do not need it. Registration must be submitted at or after 2032-02-29T09:00:00.000Z and strictly before 2032-03-01T09:00:00.000Z. For admitted participants, select the first matching rule in the following priority order and stop: a member who has guardian consent pays $9 USD; otherwise a resident pays $16 USD; otherwise a student pays $14 USD; otherwise a scholarship recipient pays $0 USD; otherwise the price is $31 USD. Scholarship status never overrides an earlier matching price and never waives admission requirements. Do not combine prices. There are no other eligibility conditions or deadlines.

Para los participantes admitidos, seleccione la primera regla coincidente en el siguiente orden de prioridad y deténgase: un miembro que tenga consentimiento del tutor paga $9 USD; en su defecto, un residente paga $16 USD; en su defecto, un estudiante paga $14 USD; en su defecto, un beneficiario de beca paga $0 USD; en su defecto, el precio es $31 USD. alice.text: Mosaic club session. A participant is eligible exactly when their age is at least 16 and at most 80, they are not someone who is none of a resident, a student, and a member, and they are either at least 18 or have guardian consent. The submission instant must be no earlier than 2032-02-29T09:00:00.000Z and earlier than 2032-03-01T09:00:00.000Z; the opening instant is included and the closing instant is excluded. Apply fees only to admitted participants. A scholarship recipient pays nothing. Among people without a scholarship, every student pays $14 USD. Among the remaining people, members with guardian consent pay $9 USD; after that, remaining residents pay $16 USD; anyone still unmatched pays $31 USD. Each person receives only the first applicable price in that order. A scholarship does not waive any admission requirement. No other eligibility conditions or deadlines apply.
